claim:
- Choose blocks, then read exact values. A lightweight index branch selects history separately for each GQA group; the main branch retains exact attention on the selection.

- Native vision changes the input contract. The released checkpoint supports text, images and video, with dynamic visual tokenization and spatial merging.
- Keep the experiment and release separate. The MSA report studies 109B models; released M3 is about 428B total and 23B active.

claim: The index branch has one query head per KV group and a shared index key head. It scores every causally visible key, takes the maximum score within each block, and selects the top blocks independently for each group. All query heads within that GQA group share the selection but retain their own main attention queries.

claim: The kernels avoid a needless softmax before top K because it preserves score ordering, and arrange sparse attention around KV blocks to improve reuse. They still incur indexing, gather, materialization and load balancing overhead. The report's 28.4 times attention FLOP reduction at 1M becomes 14.2 times prefill and 7.6 times decode attention kernel speedup on H800, under that experiment's head configuration. Neither is a whole model or application speed guarantee.

claim: Appendix C tests the efficiency tradeoffs in smaller pilot settings. Larger 128 token blocks provide coarser selection but more efficient kernels, with limited quality loss in those tests. The final design does not force a sink block or a large local window: it reserves only the incomplete self block. After indexer warmup, an extra index value head adds cost without consistent quality gains and is removed. These are scoped ablation lessons, not guarantees at every scale.

claim: The M3 card states mixed text, image and video training from the beginning. Its artifact pairs the text decoder with a 32 layer, width 1,280 vision encoder, patch size 14, spatial merging by two and temporal patches of two frames. The visual projection connects to width 6,144. The text configuration also declares seven MTP modules. This establishes an artifact setting, not verified speculative decoding support in every backend. These are released configuration facts, not the complete disclosed vision training recipe.
